title: The Ankle after Practice
story: After practice, Noor’s ankle swelled, so the coach stopped her from joining the final drill. The team medic wrapped it and told her to rest, raise the foot, and cool it for short periods. Noor wanted to play on Saturday, but the medic said a proper check came first. She booked a morning appointment and sent the coach her updated availability.

vocabulary.definition: Became larger, usually because of an injury.
A repeated exercise used in training.

quiz.question: What did the coach keep Noor out of?
options: The final drill
The morning appointment
Wrapping her own ankle
Sending a message
quiz.explanation: The coach stopped her from joining the final drill after her ankle swelled.
quiz.supportingSentence: After practice, Noor’s ankle swelled, so the coach stopped her from joining the final drill.

quiz.question: Why was Noor taken out of the last part of practice?
options: Her ankle had swollen and was not ready for more work
She had already booked the morning visit
The medic wanted her to coach the others
Saturday’s match had been cancelled
quiz.correctAnswer: Her ankle had swollen and was not ready for more work
quiz.explanation: Her ankle swelled, and that is why the coach stopped her from joining the final drill.
quiz.supportingSentence: After practice, Noor’s ankle swelled, so the coach stopped her from joining the final drill.

quiz.question: What does the updated availability suggest?
options: She may not play at the time first expected
She has been made captain of the team
The medic will play in her place
The swelling had gone before she left
quiz.correctAnswer: She may not play at the time first expected
quiz.explanation: Sending an updated availability means her ability to play is no longer certain.
quiz.supportingSentence: She booked a morning appointment and sent the coach her updated availability.

quiz.question: What does swelled mean in this story?
options: Became larger after an injury
Was covered with a bandage
Was checked by a doctor
Was cooled for a short time
quiz.explanation: Noor’s ankle swelled after practice, meaning it grew larger from the injury.
quiz.supportingSentence: After practice, Noor’s ankle swelled, so the coach stopped her from joining the final drill.

quiz.question: Why did the medic say a check had to come first?
options: Saturday’s game should wait until the ankle is assessed
Noor should cancel the appointment
The coach should stop the whole team
Rest was no longer needed
quiz.correctAnswer: Saturday’s game should wait until the ankle is assessed
quiz.explanation: Noor wanted to play on Saturday, but the medic said a proper check came first.
quiz.supportingSentence: Noor wanted to play on Saturday, but the medic said a proper check came first.
